name: Chicken Vegetable Fried Rice
description: A simple and flavorful fried rice dish made with cooked rice, beaten egg, soya sauce, and mixed vegetables.

recipeInstructions.text: Bring water to a boil. Dissolve chicken Oxo cube in water. Add rice, salt, and butter. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Drain rice in a strainer for 10 minutes.
Heat oil in a wok or frying pan. Add beaten egg and soya sauce. Cook until just setting.
Add cooked rice and vegetables to the egg mixture. Stir continuously until combined.
Adjust seasoning with salt, pepper, and additional soya sauce if needed.

keywords: chicken fried rice, vegetable fried rice, Chinese-Canadian side dish

_similar.name: Barley and Corn Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty barley casserole with corn, carrots, and garlic, perfect as a comforting side dish.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a heavy casserole. Cook onion, garlic, and carrots until the onion is softened, stirring frequently.
Stir in barley and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in vegetable stock, cover, and bake at 350 °F for 1 hour.
Test that barley is tender. Stir in corn and parsley.
Return to the oven to heat through. Season with pepper to taste.

_similar.keywords: barley casserole, corn, carrots, comforting side dish

_similar.name: Swedish Potatoes
_similar.description: A creamy mashed potato casserole topped with a buttery breadcrumb and cheese crust, serving 10 to 12 people.
recipeIngredient: 2 tsp onion salt or chopped onion

recipeInstructions.text: Cook and mash the potatoes.
Mix in the remaining ingredients except for the bread crumbs, additional butter, and grated cheese.
Put the mashed potato mixture into a greased 9x13 inch pan.
Dot the top with butter and sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Bake, covered, at 350°F for 30 minutes.
Sprinkle grated cheese over the bread crumbs on top and return to the oven until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
To reheat, cover with foil (shiny side in) and heat slowly at 250°F to 300°F.

_similar.keywords: mashed potato casserole, Swedish potatoes, cheesy potato bake

_similar.name: Green Beans and Artichokes
_similar.description: A savory side dish featuring green beans and artichoke hearts mixed with garlic, onion, and Romano cheese.
recipeIngredient: 1 (14 oz) can artichokes, drained and quartered
½ cup freshly grated Romano cheese
1 (10 oz) pkg frozen french-style green beans, cooked and drained

recipeInstructions.text: Saute the onion and garlic in olive oil until the onion is softened.
Stir in bread crumbs and cook until they absorb the oil.
Add green beans, artichoke hearts, and cheese. Combine thoroughly.
Heat slowly to soften the cheese. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

_similar.keywords: green beans, artichokes, Romano cheese, side dish

_similar.name: Broccoli Casserole
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli casserole topped with a cheesy bread crumb mixture, perfect for a comforting vegetable side.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together broccoli, celery, and mushroom soup. Place in a casserole dish.
Make the topping by combining grated cheese, melted margarine, sour cream, and bread crumbs.
Spread the topping over the casserole.
Bake at 325 °F to 350 °F for 25 to 30 minutes.

_similar.keywords: broccoli casserole, cheesy, comforting vegetable side

_similar.name: Roasted Carrots and Parsnips
_similar.description: A simple roasted vegetable dish featuring carrots, parsnips, and onions with a maple syrup and mustard glaze.
recipeIngredient: 1 lb parsnips, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces
1 lb carrots, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Place parsnips, carrots, onions, oil, and thyme in a prepared baking dish; toss until vegetables are well coated with oil.
Roast in the oven for 30 minutes.
In a small bowl, combine maple syrup and mustard.
Pour the maple syrup mixture over the vegetables and toss to coat.
Roast for another 20 to 25 minutes or until vegetables are tender and golden, stirring once.

_similar.keywords: roasted carrots, roasted parsnips, maple syrup glaze
